A '''supply carrier''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] class assigned to transport supplies. They were usually guarded by [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] escorts.<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower|reprint=1}}</ref>
